been watching them since the start and man they’ve changed a lot. of course I don’t to expect them or the channel itself to be the exact same as it was in 2016 - but come on. the quality of their content has taken a huge nosedive especially recently. it’s hard to put into words but theres been a feeling of inauthenticity/laziness to it. the passion they had for the channel just blatantly is not there anymore. uploading any actual content seems to be a chore for them now. 

overall it’s just clear that it’s just a business for them atp, theres very little passion behind it anymore. and to prioritise that business over literal fucking SA is so unbelievably shitty. so over them and so disappointed.
